variables.name: bufferBytesHeldByInflater
variables.comment:
* When we call Inflater.setInput(), the inflater keeps our byte array until
   * it needs input again. This tracks how many bytes the inflater is currently
   * holding on to.

methods.name: public long read(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
public boolean refill() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Refills the inflater with compressed data if it needs input. (And only if
   * it needs input). Returns true if the inflater required input but the source
   * was exhausted.

methods.name: private void releaseInflatedBytes() throws IOException
methods.comment: When the inflater has processed compressed data, remove it from the buffer.
